lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately equidistant with slight narrowing toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines terminate mid-flank as abbreviated segments before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper haunch align horizontally; two spots on the mid-haunch align in a vertical geometric orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes and a prominent white transverse patch located on the lower throat region.
